## Objective
- Build a complete, playable basketball game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a one-minute arcade shooting challenge with drag-to-aim controls, score/streak tracking, persistent best score, sound toggle, and responsive layout.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the playable game in `index.html`.
- Started a local server and tested the page in Playwright; verified a shot increments the score.
- Saved and inspected the latest screenshot at `screenshots/current.jpg`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally run a final gameplay and responsive-layout check.
2. Summarize the implementation and assumptions when finishing.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game UI, canvas rendering, controls, scoring, timer, and persistence.
- `screenshots/current.jpg`: Latest inspected gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The development server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; Playwright opened `http://localhost:3002`.
- Playwright confirmed the score changed to `001` after a successful shot.
